integrity: Uniform arbitrary-coefficient cochain proof; independent finite modular chain-rank checks support but do not replace the proof. No independent external scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: The proof determines first integral homology for all m,n>=4, not other groups, full homotopy type, or dimensions below 4. Prior exact 4-by-4 case is expressly excluded from claimed novelty; older general fundamental-group literature may contain an unindexed equivalent.
title: Universal first-homology two-torsion in rook-graph neighborhood complexes
